'''Rage''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the mod. The Effect increases Speed and Damage by 10%. Parasites' Abilities, such as charging or shooting projectiles, will also have a reduced cooldown.

Entities that have this Effect will constantly emit black, smoke-like particles accompanied by red stars. They will also produce a faint growling sound.

Rage cannot be removed by drinking Milk.
